reproduction_target: De novo mitochondrial genome assembly and phylogenomics pipeline for Ascaris: read QC/trimming (fastp), subsampling (seqtk), QC (FastQC), host-read depletion (Bowtie2 via SQM_mapper; Deacon) and mtDNA read enrichment (Deacon), mitogenome assembly (MitoZ), assembly QC (QUAST), alignment/manual curation (Mauve), annotation (MITOS2), annotation alignment (Clustal X2), read mapback validation (Bowtie2 + samtools), manual per-gene extraction/concatenation, neighbour-joining phylogenies (MEGA12), diversity indices (DnaSP), and R figure generation (alluvial plot, tree visualisation, clade heatmap, tanglegram). Wet-lab worm collection/dissection, DNA extraction, DNA QC and Illumina NovaSeq X Plus sequencing are out of computational-reproduction scope (W).
granularity_note: Coarse one-step-per-named-tool from Methods 2.3 and 2.4 prose, cross-checked against the GitHub README's stated section list (Initial_processing, Deacon, Bowtie2/SqueezeMeta, MitoZ_MITOS, Alluvial_plot, Tree_analysis, Clade_Heatmap, Tanglegram). Code axis scored 2 where the README declares a matching command/script section and 0 where the paper describes an explicitly manual or GUI-only operation (Mauve visual inspection and manual reverse-complement/linearisation, Clustal X2 editing, manual per-gene extraction and concatenation, MEGA12, DnaSP). Repo source was NOT read line-by-line (stage-1 rule); the repo files carry no extensions and no release/tag, so 'public+exact' here means 'a per-stage command file is declared for this step', not 'verified to reproduce the step'. Four R figure steps are kept separate because the README lists them as four separate artifacts. Bowtie2 index-build and Bowtie2 depletion are separated because the paper describes them as distinct invocations with distinct inputs.

steps.label: Adapter/quality trimming of raw reads with fastp (v0.23.4); no parameters given in prose
Subsampling each paired-end read set to 20M reads (40M total/sample) with Seqtk (v1.5-r133); samples with <20M reads per direction left unsubsampled; random seed not stated
Quality control of subsampled reads with FastQC (v0.12.1), default operation
Host reference index construction with Bowtie2-build (Bowtie2 v2.5.4) from pig GCF_000003025.6 + human GCF_000001405.40 including mitochondrial sequences
Host-read depletion by aligning 2x20M reads to the host index using the SQM_mapper script (SqueezeMeta, version 1.65post1) with Bowtie2 v2.5.4; alignment/filter settings not stated in prose
Host-read depletion with Deacon (v0.7.0): minimizer index built from the same human + pig reference genomes; minimizer/threshold settings not stated in prose
mtDNA read enrichment/filtering with Deacon (v0.7.0) against an ascarid mitogenome database (accession list in Supplementary Table S4)

De novo mitogenome assembly with MitoZ (v3.6), k = 39/59/79/99/119 (Kenyan 100 bp samples: 119 dropped, 29 added), 1 Gbp coverage for depleted reads and 0.1 Gbp for mtDNA-enriched reads; failed/partial assemblies re-run with ad hoc k additions (21 or 89) and lowered coverage
Assembly length and N50 assessment with QUAST (version 5.02), default operation

Visual inspection / multi-alignment of each assembly FASTA against the reference with Mauve Aligner (version 2015-02-26), followed by MANUAL editing to reverse-complement and linearise sequences to start at the repetitive 5' region ahead of nad1

Mitogenome annotation with standalone MITOS2 (version 2.1.9), mitochondrial standard + NCBI translation table 5; per-gene choice of NCBIcode vs standard start/stop predictions explicitly enumerated (NCBIcode for atp6/cox1/cox2/cox3/nad2/nad3/nad6; standard for cob/nad1/nad4/nad4L/nad5)
Alignment and editing of resulting annotations with Clustal X2; no parameters and no script stated
Validation mapback of 20M subsampled reads to their own assemblies for 30 samples: Bowtie2-build index of each assembly + Bowtie2 v2.5.4 alignment with --very-sensitive
Coverage / mean base depth / base quality / mapping quality computation with Samtools (version 1.22.1); exact subcommands not stated in prose

MANUAL extraction of each annotated protein-coding gene into individual files and concatenation in the fixed order nad1-atp6-nad2-cob-cox3-nad4-cox1-cox2-nad3-nad5-nad6-nad4L, excluding tRNA/rRNA and the repetitive OH region; COX1 first 8 amino acids dropped

Neighbour-joining trees with 1,000 bootstrap replicates in MEGA12 for the 12 individual nucleotide gene alignments and the 2 concatenated datasets (Maximum Composite Likelihood distances for nucleotides; Poisson correction + pairwise deletion for amino acids)
Visualisation/analysis of the resulting phylogenetic trees in R (Tree_analysis); no R version, no package versions, no session info stated in paper or README
Alluvial plot of continent x host x clade in R (Alluvial_plot); no R/package versions stated
Per-gene clade-assignment heatmap in R (Clade_Heatmap); clade membership per gene determined by manual reading of tree visualisation + bootstrap support
Tanglegram of nucleotide-tree vs amino-acid-tree sample order in R (Tanglegram); no R/package versions stated
Genetic diversity indices (S, h, pi, theta_W, K) per coding gene and for the concatenated dataset with DnaSP (version 5), DNA polymorphism function

Wet-lab: collection of 24 Ascaris worms (7 German abattoir pigs, 1 German human diagnostic case, others per Supplementary Table S1); dissection removing uteruses/intestines and separating muscle from cuticle
Wet-lab: DNA extraction with Qiagen DNeasy Blood & Tissue Kit (Cat. 69506, 50 ul AE elution re-applied) or MasterPure Complete DNA and RNA Purification Kit (Lucigen MC85200)
Wet-lab: DNA quantification/purity with Invitrogen Qubit 1X dsDNA HS kit and NanoDrop; inclusion thresholds >=5 ng/ul and A260/A280 >= 1.6
Wet-lab: whole-genome sequencing by Novogene Europe on Illumina NovaSeq X Plus, 150 bp paired-end, 30X coverage

headline.static_readiness: 0/21 (0%) - stage1 ceiling only, no R-star (R-star needs stage-2 code verification)
headline.inference_inclusive_upper_bound: 12 of 21 computational steps reach the stage-1 ceiling RI; 9 cap at NI. The RI block is the command-line assembly pipeline (fastp, seqtk, FastQC, Bowtie2 index/depletion via SQM_mapper, Deacon depletion and mtDNA enrichment, MitoZ, QUAST, MITOS2, Bowtie2 mapback, samtools), which has both exact prose version pins and a declared per-stage command file in the public repo. The 9 NI steps fail on two distinct causes: (a) explicitly manual or GUI-only operations with no executable artifact (Mauve visual inspection + manual reverse-complement/linearisation, Clustal X2 editing, manual per-gene extraction/concatenation, MEGA12 neighbour-joining, DnaSP diversity indices); (b) the four R figure scripts, which exist in the repo but have no stated R version, package versions, renv lockfile or session info, so version=0. Version cannot exceed 1 anywhere: the paper and README declare no conda environment, lockfile, or container, and the repo carries no release or tag, so the exact tool pins have no environment closure. Even a fully successful stage-2 code read would leave version capped at 1 for every step under rubric Delta-2, so this paper is not R-star-eligible without a lockfile/container being added.
headline.coverage: 21 computational steps assessed from Methods sections 2.3 and 2.4 plus the GitHub README section list; 4 wet-lab steps counted (W, OOS, not verdicted). Data availability and code availability are combined in one section 5; a public GitHub repo, an ENA BioProject (PRJEB105081) and a figshare DOI (10.6084/m9.figshare.30871202) are all stated.

gaps.where: Software environment for the whole pipeline (all 21 C-steps)
gaps.missing: No conda environment file, no lockfile (conda-lock/renv.lock/pixi.lock), no container image or digest, and no repo release/tag anywhere in the paper or the README. Exact versions ARE pinned in prose for most command-line tools (fastp v0.23.4, seqtk v1.5-r133, FastQC v0.12.1, Bowtie2 v2.5.4, SQM_mapper v1.65post1, Deacon v0.7.0, MitoZ v3.6, QUAST 5.02, Mauve 2015-02-26, MITOS2 2.1.9, samtools 1.22.1, DnaSP v5, MEGA12 major version only), but with no environment closure, so version stays at 1. R itself is entirely unversioned and the README says only 'This includes all bioinformatic tools and R packages' without listing them.
gaps.how_to_close: Ship a conda env + lockfile (or a container with a digest) covering the command-line tools, and an renv.lock or sessionInfo() dump for the R figure scripts; cut a tagged release / Zenodo DOI of the repo so the code state referenced by the paper is immutable.

gaps.where: C10 Mauve curation, C12 Clustal X2, C15 manual gene extraction/concatenation, C16 MEGA12, C21 DnaSP
gaps.missing: Five analysis steps are described as GUI-driven and/or explicitly manual ('visually inspected', 'manual editing was performed', 'manually extracted into individual files', trees 'constructed in MEGA12', diversity 'using the DNA polymorphism function'). No script, macro, session file, or exported settings exist for any of them, and the repo README lists no corresponding section. The manual curation touches the primary result path: sample SRR31692059 required hand-editing to close a 17-nt gap between cox1 and cox2.
gaps.how_to_close: Replace or supplement the manual steps with scripted equivalents (e.g. a script for orientation/linearisation, a CLI aligner for the annotation alignment, a scripted gene-extraction/concatenation step, and a CLI phylogenetics tool or a MEGA-CC .mao settings file), and deposit the exact edited intermediates for the hand-curated samples.

gaps.where: C1 fastp, C2 seqtk seed, C5 SQM_mapper/Bowtie2 depletion, C6/C7 Deacon, C8 MitoZ re-runs, C14 samtools
gaps.missing: fastp invoked with no stated parameters; seqtk subsampling seed not given (subsampling is randomised, so the 20M-read sets are not reconstructable from prose); Bowtie2 depletion alignment/filter settings and Deacon minimizer/threshold settings unstated; MitoZ re-runs used per-sample ad hoc adjustments ('further amendments to the k values (addition of k=21 or k=89) and lowered coverage requirements') with no per-sample record in the paper; samtools subcommands unstated.
gaps.how_to_close: Record the seqtk seed, publish the exact per-sample MitoZ k-mer and coverage settings as a table or config file, and state the Bowtie2/Deacon/fastp/samtools command lines in the paper (or point to the specific repo command file per step).

gaps.where: Raw sequencing reads for the 24 newly sequenced worms (inputs to C1-C8)
gaps.missing: The data availability statement deposits only the mtDNA ASSEMBLIES in ENA BioProject PRJEB105081 and the alignments in figshare. No accession is stated for the raw Illumina reads generated in this study, and the ENA project record is titled 'Ascaris mitochondrial genome assembly'. The 125 downloaded read sets and 19 downloaded mitogenomes are identified only via Supplementary Table S1 / S4, not as a machine-readable accession list in the main text (a sample_ids.txt attachment is linked from the README).
gaps.how_to_close: Deposit the newly generated raw WGS reads under a stated ENA/SRA accession and provide a machine-readable accession manifest (one row per sample, with the SRR/ERR run ids and the mitogenome accessions) in the repo.

gaps.missing: The repo is public and reachable (HTTP 200) but has no release, no tag, no license, and no commit hash cited in the paper; the nine tracked files are extensionless blobs. Two command listings (lauren_mtDNA_commands_used.txt, sample_ids.txt) are served from GitHub user-attachment URLs rather than being committed to the repository, so they are not covered by repo history.
gaps.how_to_close: Commit the command and sample-id files into the repository, add a license, and cite a tagged release or archived DOI (Zenodo/Software Heritage) in the paper so the referenced code state is fixed.

gaps.where: C16 MEGA12 clade assignment, C19 clade heatmap
gaps.missing: Clade membership per gene was assigned 'based on tree visualisation and bootstrap support' - a human judgement call that is the basis of the paper's headline claim (novel Clade D). No decision rule, threshold, or machine-readable clade assignment table is given in the Methods; the assignments enter the heatmap script as an input that is not itself derived by code.
gaps.how_to_close: State an explicit clade-calling rule (e.g. bootstrap threshold + monophyly criterion), and deposit the resulting per-sample per-gene clade assignment table as the documented input to the heatmap script.

gaps.where: W1-W4: worm collection and dissection, DNA extraction (Qiagen DNeasy / MasterPure), Qubit/NanoDrop QC, Novogene Illumina NovaSeq X Plus sequencing
gaps.missing: Wet-lab sample generation steps are out of scope for computational reproduction (OOS); counted in W, not verdicted.
gaps.how_to_close: N/A for Tier-1 computational readiness; scope is the bioinformatic pipeline.
